articles.summary: NEW YORK, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LivePerson (NASDAQ: LPSN) ("LivePerson" or "the Company"), a leading provider of predictable conversational AI, today announced that its stockholders voted to approve the proposed transaction with SoundHound AI, Inc.
articles.title: LivePerson Stockholders Approve Acquisition by SoundHound AI
